root_cause_label: Resource Exhaustion Crash During PDF Read
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent attempted to read a binary PDF file directly using the generic file-read tool, triggering a runtime crash due to resource constraints that terminated execution after only 2 steps.
t_err_evidence: Step 2: agent issues [read] /app/paper.pdf — reading a binary PDF with a generic file-read tool instead of a PDF parser library, which causes a runtime crash.
t_commit_evidence: Step 2 terminal output: 'The action has not been executed due to a runtime error. The runtime system may have crashed and restarted due to resource constraints.' — execution terminates here with no further steps.
t_surface_evidence: Step 2 terminal output: 'The runtime system may have crashed and restarted due to resource constraints.' — explicit crash message visible at step 2.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge that PDF files are binary and require a dedicated parser library (e.g., PyPDF2) rather than a raw file-read tool; using the generic read tool on a binary PDF caused a resource-exhaustion crash.
